name: t-instr
instruction: Before every choice apply these rules, in this order of priority: (1) In the month before a review month never pick a story option that may lower Skill, Network or Output (public confrontation costs Network, extra unplanned work costs Output). (2) At L4 and above, every quarter: Skill learning with Energy and Apply for rotation as main action, unless risk or low Health says otherwise. (3) If the monthly HR remark is anything but the smiling, all-right one: Lay low and reduce risk as main action and Defuse legacy risk with Energy. (4) While that remark is not clear, never pick an option that hides, denies, deceives, gossips, cuts corners or invites formal scrutiny. (5) While Wealth is only a few months of pay, refuse options that cost money. (6) In the last three months: risk back to clear, Health and Dignity up, no new risk.
